search_window.note: Conservative lookback to most recent visible completed check; exact intervening ledger state not independently established.

coverage_notes.role: Supplementary bounded recall watch only; production collector authoritative.
coverage: Sole/last/full-service grocery loss, closure, or fire
Weather/disaster-related emergency distribution cancellation or suspension
Abrupt pantry or food-bank closure or material access reduction
Official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
coverage_notes.disposition: No newly published, independently verified qualifying incident found within the bounded search window.
coverage_notes.excluded: Older reports; previously known incidents; relief-distribution promotion; store openings/renovations; ordinary grocery closures without sole/last access evidence; 2025 SNAP interruption reports.
coverage_notes.material_limitations: Search engines returned substantial older and off-topic material; no exhaustive nationwide collection or source-by-source official-site audit was attempted.
